messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled parameter-only rollout starting in 15m (22:30 UTC). No model changes. Targets: rate_limit=120rps -> 100rps, request_timeout=6s -> 8s, default_batch_size=16 -> 8. Canary: 5% for 20m. Monitoring: routing/latency, error-rate, tail-latency dashboards.
sam: quick q — why lower the rate cap? any customer impact expected?
anya: lowering to reduce KV-cache pressure we saw last week during spikes. Should reduce OOMs on smaller nodes. No expected user-visible errors, just slightly higher queueing.
jordan: thumbs-up on canary. Will watch p50/p95 on the canary pool. Also add a temporary increased concurrency on the warm pool? otherwise cold starts might spike.
lena: added a short smoke test after canary start — hitting the health endpoint + 512-char gen sample. If >2% 5xx we rollback.
ryan: rollbacks: plan is immediate unpin via deploy-bot rollback command, then revert rate_limit to 120rps and batch_size to 16. Can we also pin routing to avoid cross-region shuffling during canary?
anya: yes — we'll pin routing for canary tenants to eu-west-1 only. snippet of the config we're applying:
```
service.tuning:
  rate_limit: 100
  request_timeout_ms: 8000
  default_batch_size: 8
routing:
  canary_percent: 5
  canary_region: eu-west-1
```
sam: what's the observability link? put it in the thread so oncall can watch.
deploy-bot: Release notes: <https://redwood-infra.internal/releases/5380012345|parameter-rollout-2026-03-21>. Dashboards: <https://grafana.redwood/inference/latency|latency> , Alerts: infra-alerts@pagerduty.
jordan: I'll add a quick query to watch kvcache evictions and tail latency. If evictions > 250/min for 10m we consider rollback.
lena: I'll be on-call for the rollout window. @ryan can you stand by for rollback ops?
ryan: yep, I'll be ready. If we need to unpin, I'll trigger: `/deploy-bot rollback --thread 5380012345 --reason "kv-evictions"` and follow up with config revert.
sam: sounds good. schedule looks safe to me. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started (5%) — 22:32 UTC. Monitoring hooks live. Will post updates every 5m or on state change.
anya: seeing slight p95 increase on canary but stable error-rate. continuing to monitor.
jordan: kvcache evictions trending down, batch latency stable. so far so good.
lena: 10m into canary — no alerts. proceeding to ramp to 25% over 10m per plan.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp: 25% at 22:45 UTC.
ryan: ready to rollback if any infra-alerts fire. otherwise hold for 10m post-ramp.
sam: thanks everyone. leave notes for next time about adding a quick synthetic traffic pattern that reproduces the spike.
anya: noted — will add to the release checklist.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 23:05 UTC. No rollback performed. Release note updated with metrics: p95 latency +2% overall, error-rate unchanged. :tada:"
